1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flanges, the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void, wherein the filler comprises __a reinforcing material selected from the group consisting of unidirectional composite tape, composite laminate, hybrid tape-fabric member, and titanium__; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, wherein the composite fabric comprises __woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein the adhesive comprises __a structural adhesive applied as a folded sheet__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, and wherein the layer of adhesive includes __a folded sheet of structural adhesive that is distinct from and separate to any adhesive contained within the reinforcing fiber bundle of the filler__.

4. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes __woven__ graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, and wherein the adhesive is __applied as a separate layer distinct from adhesive resin contained within the reinforcing fiber bundle__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, and wherein the offset is created by __intentional placement rather than wrinkles or deformation__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone, wherein the reinforcing member comprises __a material selected from the group consisting of unidirectional composite tape, composite laminate, hybrid tape-fabric member, and titanium__; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, wherein the composite fabric comprises __woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, wherein the adhesive comprises __a structural adhesive applied as a wrapped sheet__.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __at least one composite patch on each of the channels and the base, wherein the patches are positioned to avoid complete coverage of the radius areas__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes __a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a separate layer distinct from any adhesive resin contained within the reinforcing member__.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges, and wherein the adhesive in the interfacial layers is __applied separately and distinct from any adhesive resin contained within the composite materials__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __formed from laminated composite tape and include woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a pair of composite channels with radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap and a base, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the composite channels, the cap and the base, wherein the composite fabric comprises __woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone, wherein the filler comprises __a material selected from the group consisting of unidirectional composite tape, composite laminate, hybrid tape-fabric member, and titanium__; and a layer of adhesive surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, wherein the adhesive comprises __a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer distinct from any adhesive resin contained within the reinforcing filler__.
